(Trading Economics data page, read 19:47 BST — data only)
The yield on United Kingdom 10Y Bond Yield rose to 5.41% on October 5, 2026, marking a 0.04 percentage points increase from the previous session. Over the past month, the yield has edged up by 0.24 points and is 0.67 points higher than a year ago, according to over-the-counter interbank yield quotes for this government bond maturity.
